blank.description: Blank/format type before burning: e.g., 'as_needed', 'fast', 'all', 'format_overwrite', 'deformat_sequential'. Empty string disables blanking.

dev.description: Drive address (e.g., /dev/sr0, 0, ATA:1,0,0). Must be a valid libburn address.

dummy.description: If true, perform a dry-run without actually burning media.

eject.description: If true, eject media after successful burn.

fifo_start_at.description: Start burning when FIFO contains this many bytes (same suffixes as fs).

fs.description: FIFO buffer size with optional suffixes: s (2048), k/K (1024), m/M (1024k), g/G (1024m).

gracetime.description: Grace time (in seconds) before burning starts. Default 0.

grow_overwriteable_iso.description: If true, enable emulated multi-session for ISO-9660 on overwriteable DVD/BD media.

padsize.description: Padding added to each data track (same suffixes as fs).

sao.description: If true, use Session-at-Once (SAO) mode for CD or Disc-at-Once (DAO) for DVD.

speed.description: Burn speed: 0 = minimal, -1 = maximal, or numeric value.

tao.description: If true, use Track-at-Once (TAO) mode for CD or Incremental Streaming for DVD.

tracks.description: List of track sources to burn. Each item must have 'source' (file path or '-' for stdin).

verbose.description: Verbosity level (0–3). Each increment adds -v to the command line.
